height-sm.$description: The small control height: a control of size sm, the actions in a table cell, a title bar or a panel header.

height-md.$description: The medium control height, every control's default size.

height-lg.$description: The large control height, for a control of size lg, such as a prominent call to action.

height.$description: The height a control takes when it sets no size: md, unless a container sets it to another control height for what it holds, as a table cell does with sm.

target-min.$description: The smallest a pressable target may be in either dimension, in both scales: WCAG 2.2's 24 px minimum. A control smaller than its size, such as a segment inside a small rail or an action inside a small field, keeps at least this.

border-width.$description: The hairline border of controls and fields, which stays 1 px in both scales.

height-touch.$description: The height every control grows to under a coarse pointer, whatever the scale, and the width of a button: its own box is its hit area. Rows grow to it too.

icon-size.$description: The icon in a control. 1 rem in both scales: icons never get smaller than this.

gap.$description: The space between a control's icon and its label.

size-md.$description: An icon beside body text, such as in a tree or a select trigger.

size-lg.$description: A leading icon in a large row, such as a list item's.

floating-height.$description: The height of a text field's floating variant, whose label rests inside the field and floats into its outline. Other fields take the control height.

height.$description: The row of a menu and of a select's or combobox's popup.

content-height.$description: The line a tree row reserves for its label and icon, 20 px in both scales; the row's density adds its block padding around it.

padding-block-xs.$description: Row density xs: the block padding of each row of a data component, such as a table, a tree or a list.

padding-block-sm.$description: Row density sm: a tree's default.

padding-block-md.$description: Row density md: the default of tables and lists.

row-padding-block-sm.$description: A tree row's block padding at density sm, its default, so that a row is as tall as a menu row in either scale: the row density's in the comfortable scale.

row-padding-block-md.$description: A tree row's block padding at density md: the row density's in the comfortable scale.

row-padding-block-lg.$description: A tree row's block padding at density lg: the row density's in the comfortable scale.

header-height.$description: The app frame's header bar, a single row that holds controls of the control height with space around them; sticky content and the sidebar headers line up with it.

height.$description: The height, and the least width, of a counter badge and a diff stat.
A window title bar drawn by the application, which holds controls of size sm.
